rewritten_query: select l_returnflag, l_linestatus, sum(l_quantity) as sum_qty, sum(l_extendedprice) as sum_base_price, sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as sum_disc_price, sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) * (1 + l_tax)) as sum_charge, avg(l_quantity) as avg_qty, avg(l_extendedprice) as avg_price, avg(l_discount) as avg_disc, count(*) as count_order from lineitem where l_shipdate <= date '1998-12-01' - interval '93' day group by l_returnflag, l_linestatus order by l_returnflag, l_linestatus;

SELECT l_returnflag, l_linestatus, SUM(l_quantity) AS sum_qty, SUM(l_extendedprice) AS sum_base_price, SUM(disc_price) AS sum_disc_price, SUM(disc_price * (1 + l_tax)) AS sum_charge, AVG(l_quantity) AS avg_qty, AVG(l_extendedprice) AS avg_price, AVG(l_discount) AS avg_disc, COUNT(*) AS count_order FROM ( SELECT l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) AS disc_price, l_discount, l_tax FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate <= DATE '1998-09-25' ) AS precomputed GROUP BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus ORDER BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus;

select l_returnflag, l_linestatus, sum(l_quantity) as sum_qty, sum(l_extendedprice) as sum_base_price, sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as sum_disc_price, sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) * (1 + l_tax)) as sum_charge, avg(l_quantity) as avg_qty, avg(l_extendedprice) as avg_price, avg(l_discount) as avg_disc, count(*) as count_order from lineitem where l_shipdate <= date '1998-12-01' - interval '91' day group by l_returnflag, l_linestatus order by l_returnflag, l_linestatus;

WITH min_supplycosts AS ( SELECT ps_partkey, MIN(ps_supplycost) AS min_ps_supplycost FROM partsupp INNER JOIN supplier ON supplier.s_suppkey = partsupp.ps_suppkey INNER JOIN nation ON nation.n_nationkey = supplier.s_nationkey INNER JOIN region ON region.r_regionkey = nation.n_regionkey WHERE region.r_name = 'EUROPE' GROUP BY ps_partkey ) SELECT s.s_acctbal, s.s_name, n.n_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_mfgr, s.s_address, s.s_phone, s.s_comment FROM part p INNER JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey INNER JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey INNER JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey INNER JOIN min_supplycosts m ON p.p_partkey = m.ps_partkey AND ps.ps_supplycost = m.min_ps_supplycost WHERE p.p_size = 6 AND p.p_type LIKE '%NICKEL' ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC, n.n_name, s.s_name, p.p_partkey LIMIT 100;

WITH min_supply_costs AS ( SELECT ps_partkey, MIN(ps_supplycost) AS min_ps_supplycost FROM partsupp JOIN supplier ON partsupp.ps_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey JOIN nation ON supplier.s_nationkey = nation.n_nationkey JOIN region ON nation.n_regionkey = region.r_regionkey WHERE region.r_name = 'ASIA' GROUP BY ps_partkey ) SELECT s_acctbal, s_name, n_name, p_partkey, p_mfgr, s_address, s_phone, s_comment FROM part JOIN partsupp ON part.p_partkey = partsupp.ps_partkey JOIN supplier ON partsupp.ps_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey JOIN nation ON supplier.s_nationkey = nation.n_nationkey JOIN region ON nation.n_regionkey = region.r_regionkey JOIN min_supply_costs msc ON part.p_partkey = msc.ps_partkey AND partsupp.ps_supplycost = msc.min_ps_supplycost WHERE part.p_size = 46 AND part.p_type LIKE '%NICKEL' AND region.r_name = 'ASIA' ORDER BY s_acctbal DESC, n_name, s_name, p_partkey LIMIT 100;

WITH min_ps AS ( SELECT ps_partkey, MIN(ps_supplycost) AS min_supplycost FROM partsupp JOIN part ON part.p_partkey = partsupp.ps_partkey JOIN supplier ON supplier.s_suppkey = partsupp.ps_suppkey JOIN nation ON nation.n_nationkey = supplier.s_nationkey JOIN region ON region.r_regionkey = nation.n_regionkey WHERE region.r_name = 'AMERICA' AND part.p_size = 3 AND part.p_type LIKE '%NICKEL' GROUP BY ps_partkey ) SELECT s_acctbal, s_name, n_name, p_partkey, p_mfgr, s_address, s_phone, s_comment FROM part JOIN partsupp ON part.p_partkey = partsupp.ps_partkey JOIN supplier ON supplier.s_suppkey = partsupp.ps_suppkey JOIN nation ON nation.n_nationkey = supplier.s_nationkey JOIN region ON region.r_regionkey = nation.n_regionkey JOIN min_ps ON min_ps.ps_partkey = part.p_partkey AND partsupp.ps_supplycost = min_ps.min_supplycost WHERE region.r_name = 'AMERICA' AND part.p_size = 3 AND part.p_type LIKE '%NICKEL' ORDER BY s_acctbal DESC, n_name, s_name, p_partkey LIMIT 100;

select l_orderkey, sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as revenue, o_orderdate, o_shippriority from customer, orders, lineitem where c_mktsegment = 'MACHINERY' and c_custkey = o_custkey and l_orderkey = o_orderkey and o_orderdate < date '1995-03-20' and l_shipdate > date '1995-03-20' group by l_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_shippriority order by revenue desc, o_orderdate limit 10;

SELECT o.o_orderkey AS l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, o.o_orderdate, o.o_shippriority FROM customer c INNER JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey INNER JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE c.c_mktsegment = 'MACHINERY' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-03-14' AND l.l_shipdate > DATE '1995-03-14' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_shippriority ORDER BY revenue DESC, o.o_orderdate LIMIT 10;

select l_orderkey, sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as revenue, o_orderdate, o_shippriority from customer, orders, lineitem where c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' and c_custkey = o_custkey and l_orderkey = o_orderkey and o_orderdate < date '1995-03-08' and l_shipdate > date '1995-03-08' group by l_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_shippriority order by revenue desc, o_orderdate limit 10;

select o_orderpriority, count(*) as order_count from orders where o_orderdate >= date '1996-01-01' and o_orderdate < date '1996-01-01' + interval '3' month and exists ( select * from lineitem where l_orderkey = o_orderkey and l_commitdate < l_receiptdate ) group by o_orderpriority order by o_orderpriority;

select o_orderpriority, count(*) as order_count from orders where o_orderdate >= date '1995-01-01' and o_orderdate < date '1995-01-01' + interval '3' month and exists ( select * from lineitem where l_orderkey = o_orderkey and l_commitdate < l_receiptdate ) group by o_orderpriority order by o_orderpriority;

select o_orderpriority, count(*) as order_count from orders where o_orderdate >= date '1994-02-01' and o_orderdate < date '1994-02-01' + interval '3' month and exists ( select * from lineitem where l_orderkey = o_orderkey and l_commitdate < l_receiptdate ) group by o_orderpriority order by o_orderpriority;

SELECT n.n_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE r.r_name = 'AMERICA' AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1993-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1993-01-01' + INTERVAL '1' YEAR GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE r.r_name = 'AMERICA' AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-01-01' + INTERVAL '1' YEAR GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY revenue DESC;

select n_name, sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as revenue from customer, orders, lineitem, supplier, nation, region where c_custkey = o_custkey and l_orderkey = o_orderkey and l_suppkey = s_suppkey and c_nationkey = s_nationkey and s_nationkey = n_nationkey and n_regionkey = r_regionkey and r_name = 'EUROPE' and o_orderdate >= date '1995-01-01' and o_orderdate < date '1995-01-01' + interval '1' year group by n_name order by revenue desc;

select sum(l_extendedprice * l_discount) as revenue from lineitem where l_shipdate >= date '1993-01-01' and l_shipdate < date '1993-01-01' + interval '1' year and l_discount between 0.03 - 0.01 and 0.03 + 0.01 and l_quantity < 24;

select sum(l_extendedprice * l_discount) as revenue from lineitem where l_shipdate >= date '1995-01-01' and l_shipdate < date '1995-01-01' + interval '1' year and l_discount between 0.03 - 0.01 and 0.03 + 0.01 and l_quantity < 24;

select sum(l_extendedprice * l_discount) as revenue from lineitem where l_shipdate >= date '1995-01-01' and l_shipdate < date '1995-01-01' + interval '1' year and l_discount between 0.09 - 0.01 and 0.09 + 0.01 and l_quantity < 24;

SELECT supp_nation, cust_nation, l_year, SUM(volume) AS revenue FROM ( SELECT n1.n_name AS supp_nation, n2.n_name AS cust_nation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS l_year, l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) AS volume FROM lineitem JOIN supplier ON lineitem.l_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey JOIN nation n1 ON supplier.s_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey AND n1.n_name IN ('CANADA', 'CHINA') JOIN orders ON lineitem.l_orderkey = orders.o_orderkey JOIN customer ON orders.o_custkey = customer.c_custkey JOIN nation n2 ON customer.c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey AND n2.n_name IN ('CANADA', 'CHINA') WHERE l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' AND n1.n_name <> n2.n_name ) AS shipping GROUP BY supp_nation, cust_nation, l_year ORDER BY supp_nation, cust_nation, l_year

SELECT n1.n_name AS supp_nation, n2.n_name AS cust_nation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS l_year, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS revenue FROM supplier JOIN nation n1 ON supplier.s_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey JOIN lineitem ON supplier.s_suppkey = lineitem.l_suppkey JOIN orders ON lineitem.l_orderkey = orders.o_orderkey JOIN customer ON orders.o_custkey = customer.c_custkey JOIN nation n2 ON customer.c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey WHERE (n1.n_name, n2.n_name) IN (('ETHIOPIA', 'FRANCE'), ('FRANCE', 'ETHIOPIA')) AND l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY n1.n_name, n2.n_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) ORDER BY supp_nation, cust_nation, l_year;

WITH filtered_lineitem AS ( SELECT * FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' ) SELECT supp_nation, cust_nation, l_year, SUM(volume) AS revenue FROM ( SELECT n1.n_name AS supp_nation, n2.n_name AS cust_nation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS l_year, l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) AS volume FROM supplier JOIN nation n1 ON supplier.s_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey AND n1.n_name = 'UNITED STATES' JOIN filtered_lineitem ON supplier.s_suppkey = filtered_lineitem.l_suppkey JOIN orders ON filtered_lineitem.l_orderkey = orders.o_orderkey JOIN customer ON orders.o_custkey = customer.c_custkey JOIN nation n2 ON customer.c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey AND n2.n_name = 'ALGERIA' UNION ALL SELECT n1.n_name AS supp_nation, n2.n_name AS cust_nation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS l_year, l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) AS volume FROM supplier JOIN nation n1 ON supplier.s_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey AND n1.n_name = 'ALGERIA' JOIN filtered_lineitem ON supplier.s_suppkey = filtered_lineitem.l_suppkey JOIN orders ON filtered_lineitem.l_orderkey = orders.o_orderkey JOIN customer ON orders.o_custkey = customer.c_custkey JOIN nation n2 ON customer.c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey AND n2.n_name = 'UNITED STATES' ) AS shipping GROUP BY supp_nation, cust_nation, l_year ORDER BY supp_nation, cust_nation, l_year;

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM orders.o_orderdate) AS o_year, SUM(CASE WHEN n2.n_name = 'CANADA' THEN lineitem.l_extendedprice * (1 - lineitem.l_discount) ELSE 0 END) / SUM(lineitem.l_extendedprice * (1 - lineitem.l_discount)) AS mkt_share FROM region JOIN nation n1 ON n1.n_regionkey = region.r_regionkey AND region.r_name = 'AMERICA' JOIN customer ON customer.c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey JOIN orders ON orders.o_custkey = customer.c_custkey AND orders.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' JOIN lineitem ON lineitem.l_orderkey = orders.o_orderkey JOIN part ON part.p_partkey = lineitem.l_partkey AND part.p_type = 'ECONOMY PLATED STEEL' JOIN supplier ON supplier.s_suppkey = lineitem.l_suppkey JOIN nation n2 ON supplier.s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM orders.o_orderdate) ORDER BY o_year;

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM orders.o_orderdate) AS o_year, SUM(CASE WHEN n2.n_name = 'FRANCE' THEN lineitem.l_extendedprice * (1 - lineitem.l_discount) ELSE 0 END) / SUM(lineitem.l_extendedprice * (1 - lineitem.l_discount)) AS mkt_share FROM region INNER JOIN nation n1 ON n1.n_regionkey = region.r_regionkey INNER JOIN customer ON customer.c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey INNER JOIN orders ON orders.o_custkey = customer.c_custkey AND orders.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' INNER JOIN lineitem ON lineitem.l_orderkey = orders.o_orderkey INNER JOIN part ON part.p_partkey = lineitem.l_partkey AND part.p_type = 'SMALL ANODIZED TIN' INNER JOIN supplier ON supplier.s_suppkey = lineitem.l_suppkey INNER JOIN nation n2 ON supplier.s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey WHERE region.r_name = 'EUROPE' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM orders.o_orderdate) ORDER BY o_year;

WITH african_nations AS ( SELECT n_nationkey, n_name FROM nation JOIN region ON n_regionkey = r_regionkey WHERE r_name = 'AFRICA' ) SELECT o_year, SUM(CASE WHEN supplier_nation = 'ALGERIA' THEN volume ELSE 0 END) / SUM(volume) AS mkt_share FROM ( SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) AS o_year, l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) AS volume, n2.n_name AS supplier_nation FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN african_nations n1 ON c.c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n2 ON s.s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey WHERE p.p_type = 'LARGE BURNISHED TIN' AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' ) AS all_nations GROUP BY o_year ORDER BY o_year;

SELECT n_name AS nation, EXTRACT(year FROM o_orderdate) AS o_year, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) - (ps_supplycost * l_quantity)) AS sum_profit FROM part JOIN lineitem ON part.p_partkey = lineitem.l_partkey JOIN partsupp ON lineitem.l_partkey = partsupp.ps_partkey AND lineitem.l_suppkey = partsupp.ps_suppkey JOIN orders ON lineitem.l_orderkey = orders.o_orderkey JOIN supplier ON lineitem.l_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey JOIN nation ON supplier.s_nationkey = nation.n_nationkey WHERE part.p_name LIKE '%red%' GROUP BY n_name, EXTRACT(year FROM o_orderdate) ORDER BY nation, o_year DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) AS o_year, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) - ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS sum_profit FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE p.p_name LIKE '%chocolate%' GROUP BY n.n_name, o_year ORDER BY nation, o_year DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) AS o_year, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) - ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS sum_profit FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey AND ps.ps_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE p.p_name LIKE '%medium%' GROUP BY n.n_name, o_year ORDER BY nation, o_year DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, cr.revenue, c.c_acctbal, n.n_name, c.c_address, c.c_phone, c.c_comment FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN ( SELECT o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1994-12-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1994-12-01' + INTERVAL '3' MONTH AND l.l_returnflag = 'R' GROUP BY o.o_custkey ) cr ON c.c_custkey = cr.o_custkey ORDER BY cr.revenue DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, cust_revenue.revenue, c.c_acctbal, n.n_name, c.c_address, c.c_phone, c.c_comment FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN ( SELECT o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1993-11-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1993-11-01' + INTERVAL '3' MONTH AND l.l_returnflag = 'R' GROUP BY o.o_custkey ) cust_revenue ON c.c_custkey = cust_revenue.o_custkey ORDER BY cust_revenue.revenue DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, cust_revenue.revenue, c.c_acctbal, n.n_name, c.c_address, c.c_phone, c.c_comment FROM ( SELECT o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= date '1993-09-01' AND o_orderdate < date '1993-09-01' + interval '3' month AND l.l_returnflag = 'R' GROUP BY o.o_custkey ) AS cust_revenue JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = cust_revenue.o_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey ORDER BY cust_revenue.revenue DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT ps_partkey, value FROM ( SELECT ps_partkey, SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) AS value, SUM(SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty)) OVER () * 0.0001000000 AS threshold FROM partsupp JOIN supplier ON partsupp.ps_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey JOIN nation ON supplier.s_nationkey = nation.n_nationkey WHERE nation.n_name = 'ROMANIA' GROUP BY ps_partkey ) t WHERE value > threshold ORDER BY value DESC;

WITH iran_partsupp AS ( SELECT ps_partkey, ps_supplycost * ps_availqty AS value_item FROM partsupp JOIN supplier ON partsupp.ps_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey JOIN nation ON supplier.s_nationkey = nation.n_nationkey WHERE nation.n_name = 'IRAN' ), total_value AS ( SELECT SUM(value_item) AS total FROM iran_partsupp ) SELECT ps_partkey, SUM(value_item) AS value FROM iran_partsupp GROUP BY ps_partkey HAVING SUM(value_item) > (SELECT total * 0.0001000000 FROM total_value) ORDER BY value DESC;

SELECT ps_partkey, value FROM ( SELECT ps_partkey, SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) AS value, SUM(SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty)) OVER () * 0.0001000000 AS threshold FROM partsupp INNER JOIN supplier ON partsupp.ps_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey INNER JOIN nation ON supplier.s_nationkey = nation.n_nationkey WHERE nation.n_name = 'JORDAN' GROUP BY ps_partkey ) t WHERE value > threshold ORDER BY value DESC;

WITH filtered_lineitem AS ( SELECT l_orderkey, l_shipmode FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipmode IN ('REG AIR', 'AIR') AND l_commitdate < l_receiptdate AND l_shipdate < l_commitdate AND l_receiptdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND l_receiptdate < DATE '1996-01-01' ) SELECT l_shipmode, SUM(CASE WHEN o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' OR o_orderpriority = '2-HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_line_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o_orderpriority <> '1-URGENT' AND o_orderpriority <> '2-HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_line_count FROM filtered_lineitem JOIN orders ON l_orderkey = o_orderkey GROUP BY l_shipmode ORDER BY l_shipmode;

WITH filtered_lineitem AS ( SELECT l_orderkey, l_shipmode FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipmode IN ('TRUCK', 'SHIP') AND l_commitdate < l_receiptdate AND l_shipdate < l_commitdate AND l_receiptdate >= DATE '1993-01-01' AND l_receiptdate < DATE '1993-01-01' + INTERVAL '1' YEAR ) SELECT f.l_shipmode, SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_line_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority NOT IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_line_count FROM filtered_lineitem f JOIN orders o ON f.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY f.l_shipmode ORDER BY f.l_shipmode;

WITH filtered_lineitem AS ( SELECT l_orderkey, l_shipmode FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipmode IN ('REG AIR', 'FOB') AND l_commitdate < l_receiptdate AND l_shipdate < l_commitdate AND l_receiptdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l_receiptdate < DATE '1997-01-01' + INTERVAL '1' YEAR ) SELECT fl.l_shipmode, SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_line_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority NOT IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_line_count FROM orders o JOIN filtered_lineitem fl ON o.o_orderkey = fl.l_orderkey GROUP BY fl.l_shipmode ORDER BY fl.l_shipmode;

WITH filtered_orders AS ( SELECT o_custkey, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE o_comment NOT LIKE '%special%requests%' GROUP BY o_custkey ) SELECT c_count, COUNT(*) AS custdist FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(ord.order_count, 0) AS c_count FROM customer LEFT JOIN filtered_orders ord ON customer.c_custkey = ord.o_custkey ) AS c_orders GROUP BY c_count ORDER BY custdist DESC, c_count DESC;

select c_count, count(*) as custdist from ( select c.c_custkey, coalesce(ord.agg_count, 0) as c_count from customer c left join ( select o_custkey, count(*) as agg_count from orders where o_comment not like '%unusual%deposits%' group by o_custkey ) ord on c.c_custkey = ord.o_custkey ) as c_orders group by c_count order by custdist desc, c_count desc;

select c_count, count(*) as custdist from ( select c_custkey, count(o_orderkey) from customer left outer join orders on c_custkey = o_custkey and o_comment not like '%express%deposits%' group by c_custkey ) as c_orders (c_custkey, c_count) group by c_count order by custdist desc, c_count desc;

SELECT 100.00 * SUM(CASE WHEN p_type LIKE 'PROMO%' THEN discounted_price ELSE 0 END) / SUM(discounted_price) AS promo_revenue FROM ( SELECT l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) AS discounted_price, p_type FROM lineitem l INNER JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1995-05-01' AND l_shipdate < DATE '1995-06-01' ) AS t;

SELECT 100.00 * SUM(CASE WHEN p_type LIKE 'PROMO%' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) / SUM(revenue) AS promo_revenue FROM ( SELECT p_type, l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) AS revenue FROM lineitem JOIN part ON l_partkey = p_partkey WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-10-01' AND l_shipdate < DATE '1997-10-01' + INTERVAL '1' month ) AS data;

WITH lineitem_agg AS ( SELECT l_partkey, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS total_price FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-03-01' AND l_shipdate < DATE '1997-03-01' + INTERVAL '1' month GROUP BY l_partkey ) SELECT 100.00 * SUM(CASE WHEN p_type LIKE 'PROMO%' THEN total_price ELSE 0 END) / SUM(total_price) AS promo_revenue FROM lineitem_agg JOIN part ON lineitem_agg.l_partkey = part.p_partkey;

SELECT p_brand, p_type, p_size, COUNT(*) AS supplier_cnt FROM ( SELECT p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, ps.ps_suppkey FROM part p INNER JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE p.p_brand <> 'Brand#43' AND p.p_type NOT LIKE 'PROMO PLATED%' AND p.p_size IN (18, 8, 33, 17, 27, 6, 1, 50) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey AND s.s_comment LIKE '%Customer%Complaints%' ) GROUP BY p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, ps.ps_suppkey ) AS distinct_suppliers GROUP BY p_brand, p_type, p_size ORDER BY supplier_cnt DESC, p_brand, p_type, p_size;

select p_brand, p_type, p_size, count(distinct ps_suppkey) as supplier_cnt from partsupp, part where p_partkey = ps_partkey and p_brand <> 'Brand#43' and p_type not like 'MEDIUM BURNISHED%' and p_size in (48, 45, 42, 31, 44, 33, 50, 3) and ps_suppkey not in ( select s_suppkey from supplier where s_comment like '%Customer%Complaints%' ) group by p_brand, p_type, p_size order by supplier_cnt desc, p_brand, p_type, p_size;

select p_brand, p_type, p_size, count(distinct ps_suppkey) as supplier_cnt from part inner join partsupp on part.p_partkey = partsupp.ps_partkey left outer join ( select s_suppkey from supplier where s_comment like '%Customer%Complaints%' ) s on partsupp.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey where p_brand <> 'Brand#33' and p_type not like 'SMALL BRUSHED%' and p_size in (28, 8, 22, 14, 19, 44, 47, 45) and s.s_suppkey is null group by p_brand, p_type, p_size order by supplier_cnt desc, p_brand, p_type, p_size;

WITH filtered_parts AS ( SELECT p_partkey FROM part WHERE p_brand = 'Brand#35' AND p_container = 'LG PKG' ), relevant_lineitems AS ( SELECT l.l_extendedprice, l.l_quantity, 0.2 * AVG(l.l_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY l.l_partkey) AS threshold FROM lineitem l JOIN filtered_parts fp ON l.l_partkey = fp.p_partkey ) SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice) / 7.0 AS avg_yearly FROM relevant_lineitems WHERE l_quantity < threshold;

WITH filtered_part AS ( SELECT p_partkey FROM part WHERE p_brand = 'Brand#32' AND p_container = 'WRAP PKG' ), part_lineitem AS ( SELECT fp.p_partkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice FROM filtered_part fp JOIN lineitem l ON fp.p_partkey = l.l_partkey ), part_avg AS ( SELECT p_partkey, 0.2 * AVG(l_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM part_lineitem GROUP BY p_partkey ) SELECT SUM(pli.l_extendedprice) / 7.0 AS avg_yearly FROM part_lineitem pli JOIN part_avg ON pli.p_partkey = part_avg.p_partkey WHERE pli.l_quantity < part_avg.avg_quantity;

WITH filtered_part AS ( SELECT p_partkey FROM part WHERE p_brand = 'Brand#32' AND p_container = 'MED PKG' ), part_threshold AS ( SELECT l.l_partkey, 0.2 * AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_threshold FROM lineitem l JOIN filtered_part fp ON l.l_partkey = fp.p_partkey GROUP BY l.l_partkey ) SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice) / 7.0 AS avg_yearly FROM lineitem l JOIN filtered_part fp ON l.l_partkey = fp.p_partkey JOIN part_threshold pt ON l.l_partkey = pt.l_partkey WHERE l.l_quantity < pt.avg_threshold;

WITH order_totals AS ( SELECT l_orderkey, SUM(l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_orderkey HAVING SUM(l_quantity) > 315 ) SELECT c_name, c_custkey, o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice, total_quantity AS sum FROM customer JOIN orders ON customer.c_custkey = orders.o_custkey JOIN order_totals ON orders.o_orderkey = order_totals.l_orderkey ORDER BY o_totalprice DESC, o_orderdate LIMIT 100;

WITH qualified_orders AS ( SELECT l_orderkey, SUM(l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_orderkey HAVING SUM(l_quantity) > 313 ) SELECT c.c_name, c.c_custkey, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, qo.total_quantity FROM qualified_orders qo JOIN orders o ON qo.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC, o.o_orderdate LIMIT 100;

WITH order_sums AS ( SELECT l_orderkey, SUM(l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_orderkey HAVING SUM(l_quantity) > 313 ) SELECT c_name, c_custkey, o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice, total_quantity FROM customer JOIN orders ON customer.c_custkey = orders.o_custkey JOIN order_sums ON orders.o_orderkey = order_sums.l_orderkey ORDER BY o_totalprice DESC, o_orderdate LIMIT 100;

SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS revenue FROM ( SELECT l_extendedprice, l_discount FROM lineitem JOIN part ON lineitem.l_partkey = part.p_partkey WHERE part.p_brand = 'Brand#21' AND part.p_container IN ('SM CASE', 'SM BOX', 'SM PACK', 'SM PKG') AND lineitem.l_quantity BETWEEN 3 AND 13 AND part.p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND lineitem.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'AIR REG') AND lineitem.l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON' UNION ALL SELECT l_extendedprice, l_discount FROM lineitem JOIN part ON lineitem.l_partkey = part.p_partkey WHERE part.p_brand = 'Brand#42' AND part.p_container IN ('MED BAG', 'MED BOX', 'MED PKG', 'MED PACK') AND lineitem.l_quantity BETWEEN 20 AND 30 AND part.p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND lineitem.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'AIR REG') AND lineitem.l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON' UNION ALL SELECT l_extendedprice, l_discount FROM lineitem JOIN part ON lineitem.l_partkey = part.p_partkey WHERE part.p_brand = 'Brand#31' AND part.p_container IN ('LG CASE', 'LG BOX', 'LG PACK', 'LG PKG') AND lineitem.l_quantity BETWEEN 25 AND 35 AND part.p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 15 AND lineitem.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'AIR REG') AND lineitem.l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON' ) AS combined;

SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS revenue FROM ( SELECT l_extendedprice, l_discount FROM lineitem JOIN part ON p_partkey = l_partkey WHERE p_brand = 'Brand#55' AND p_container IN ('SM CASE', 'SM BOX', 'SM PACK', 'SM PKG') AND l_quantity BETWEEN 10 AND 20 AND p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'AIR REG') AND l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON' UNION ALL SELECT l_extendedprice, l_discount FROM lineitem JOIN part ON p_partkey = l_partkey WHERE p_brand = 'Brand#53' AND p_container IN ('MED BAG', 'MED BOX', 'MED PKG', 'MED PACK') AND l_quantity BETWEEN 18 AND 28 AND p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'AIR REG') AND l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON' UNION ALL SELECT l_extendedprice, l_discount FROM lineitem JOIN part ON p_partkey = l_partkey WHERE p_brand = 'Brand#54' AND p_container IN ('LG CASE', 'LG BOX', 'LG PACK', 'LG PKG') AND l_quantity BETWEEN 24 AND 34 AND p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 15 AND l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'AIR REG') AND l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON' ) AS combined;

SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS revenue FROM ( SELECT l_extendedprice, l_discount FROM part JOIN lineitem ON part.p_partkey = lineitem.l_partkey WHERE p_brand = 'Brand#31' AND p_container IN ('SM CASE', 'SM BOX', 'SM PACK', 'SM PKG') AND p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND l_quantity BETWEEN 10 AND 20 AND l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'AIR REG') AND l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON' UNION ALL SELECT l_extendedprice, l_discount FROM part JOIN lineitem ON part.p_partkey = lineitem.l_partkey WHERE p_brand = 'Brand#22' AND p_container IN ('MED BAG', 'MED BOX', 'MED PKG', 'MED PACK') AND p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND l_quantity BETWEEN 19 AND 29 AND l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'AIR REG') AND l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON' UNION ALL SELECT l_extendedprice, l_discount FROM part JOIN lineitem ON part.p_partkey = lineitem.l_partkey WHERE p_brand = 'Brand#25' AND p_container IN ('LG CASE', 'LG BOX', 'LG PACK', 'LG PKG') AND p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 15 AND l_quantity BETWEEN 27 AND 37 AND l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'AIR REG') AND l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON' ) AS combined;

WITH german_suppliers AS ( SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, s_address FROM supplier INNER JOIN nation ON supplier.s_nationkey = nation.n_nationkey WHERE n_name = 'GERMANY' ), burnished_parts AS ( SELECT p_partkey FROM part WHERE p_name LIKE 'burnished%' ), line_agg AS ( SELECT l_partkey, l_suppkey, 0.5 * SUM(l_quantity) AS half_sum FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l_shipdate < DATE '1996-01-01' + INTERVAL '1' YEAR GROUP BY l_partkey, l_suppkey ), filtered_partsupp AS ( SELECT DISTINCT partsupp.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp INNER JOIN burnished_parts bp ON partsupp.ps_partkey = bp.p_partkey INNER JOIN line_agg la ON partsupp.ps_partkey = la.l_partkey AND partsupp.ps_suppkey = la.l_suppkey WHERE partsupp.ps_availqty > la.half_sum ) SELECT gs.s_name, gs.s_address FROM german_suppliers gs INNER JOIN filtered_partsupp fp ON gs.s_suppkey = fp.ps_suppkey ORDER BY gs.s_name;

WITH part_spring AS ( SELECT p_partkey FROM part WHERE p_name LIKE 'spring%' ), lineitem_agg AS ( SELECT l_partkey, l_suppkey, SUM(l_quantity) * 0.5 AS half_total FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' + INTERVAL '1' YEAR GROUP BY l_partkey, l_suppkey ) SELECT s_name, s_address FROM supplier JOIN nation ON supplier.s_nationkey = nation.n_nationkey WHERE nation.n_name = 'KENYA' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM partsupp INNER JOIN part_spring ON partsupp.ps_partkey = part_spring.p_partkey LEFT JOIN lineitem_agg la ON la.l_partkey = partsupp.ps_partkey AND la.l_suppkey = partsupp.ps_suppkey WHERE partsupp.ps_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey AND partsupp.ps_availqty > la.half_total ) ORDER BY s_name;

WITH filtered_parts AS ( SELECT p_partkey FROM part WHERE p_name LIKE 'burlywood%' ), lineitem_agg AS ( SELECT l_partkey, l_suppkey, SUM(l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND l_shipdate < DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY l_partkey, l_suppkey ), filtered_partsupp AS ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps INNER JOIN filtered_parts fp ON ps.ps_partkey = fp.p_partkey INNER JOIN lineitem_agg la ON ps.ps_partkey = la.l_partkey AND ps.ps_suppkey = la.l_suppkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 0.5 * la.total_quantity ) SELECT s.s_name, s.s_address FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_name = 'ETHIOPIA' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM filtered_partsupp fps WHERE fps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) ORDER BY s.s_name;

with order_stats as ( select l_orderkey, count(distinct l_suppkey) as num_suppliers, count(distinct case when l_receiptdate > l_commitdate then l_suppkey end) as num_delayed_suppliers from lineitem group by l_orderkey ) select s_name, count(*) as numwait from supplier join nation on supplier.s_nationkey = nation.n_nationkey and nation.n_name = 'MOZAMBIQUE' join lineitem l1 on supplier.s_suppkey = l1.l_suppkey join orders on orders.o_orderkey = l1.l_orderkey and orders.o_orderstatus = 'F' join order_stats os on l1.l_orderkey = os.l_orderkey where l1.l_receiptdate > l1.l_commitdate and os.num_suppliers >= 2 and os.num_delayed_suppliers = 1 group by s_name order by numwait desc, s_name limit 100;

WITH filtered_orders AS ( SELECT o_orderkey FROM orders WHERE o_orderstatus = 'F' ), lineitem_filtered AS ( SELECT l_orderkey, l_suppkey, l_receiptdate, l_commitdate FROM lineitem WHERE l_orderkey IN (SELECT o_orderkey FROM filtered_orders) ), filtered_suppliers AS ( SELECT s_suppkey, s_name FROM supplier JOIN nation ON s_nationkey = n_nationkey WHERE n_name = 'SAUDI ARABIA' ) SELECT s.s_name, COUNT(*) AS numwait FROM filtered_suppliers s JOIN lineitem_filtered l1 ON s.s_suppkey = l1.l_suppkey WHERE l1.l_receiptdate > l1.l_commitdate AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineitem_filtered l2 WHERE l2.l_orderkey = l1.l_orderkey AND l2.l_suppkey <> l1.l_suppkey ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineitem_filtered l3 WHERE l3.l_orderkey = l1.l_orderkey AND l3.l_suppkey <> l1.l_suppkey AND l3.l_receiptdate > l3.l_commitdate ) GROUP BY s.s_name ORDER BY numwait DESC, s.s_name LIMIT 100;

select s_name, count(*) as numwait from supplier, lineitem l1, orders, nation where s_suppkey = l1.l_suppkey and o_orderkey = l1.l_orderkey and o_orderstatus = 'F' and l1.l_receiptdate > l1.l_commitdate and exists ( select * from lineitem l2 where l2.l_orderkey = l1.l_orderkey and l2.l_suppkey <> l1.l_suppkey ) and not exists ( select * from lineitem l3 where l3.l_orderkey = l1.l_orderkey and l3.l_suppkey <> l1.l_suppkey and l3.l_receiptdate > l3.l_commitdate ) and s_nationkey = n_nationkey and n_name = 'INDONESIA' group by s_name order by numwait desc, s_name limit 100;

select cntrycode, count(*) as numcust, sum(c_acctbal) as totacctbal from ( select substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) as cntrycode, c_acctbal from customer where substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) in ('17', '22', '12', '18', '34', '25', '16') and c_acctbal > ( select avg(c_acctbal) from customer where c_acctbal > 0.00 and substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) in ('17', '22', '12', '18', '34', '25', '16') ) and not exists ( select * from orders where o_custkey = c_custkey ) ) as custsale group by cntrycode order by cntrycode;

select cntrycode, count(*) as numcust, sum(c_acctbal) as totacctbal from ( select substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) as cntrycode, c_acctbal from customer where substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) in ('24', '31', '26', '34', '30', '22', '14') and c_acctbal > ( select avg(c_acctbal) from customer where c_acctbal > 0.00 and substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) in ('24', '31', '26', '34', '30', '22', '14') ) and not exists ( select * from orders where o_custkey = c_custkey ) ) as custsale group by cntrycode order by cntrycode;

WITH avg_balance AS ( SELECT avg(c_acctbal) AS avg_val FROM customer WHERE c_acctbal > 0.00 AND substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) in ('15', '18', '31', '33', '32', '28', '16') ) SELECT cntrycode, count(*) AS numcust, sum(c_acctbal) AS totacctbal FROM ( SELECT substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) AS cntrycode, c_acctbal, c_custkey FROM customer WHERE substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) in ('15', '18', '31', '33', '32', '28', '16') ) cust WHERE c_acctbal > (SELECT avg_val FROM avg_balance) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE o_custkey = cust.c_custkey ) GROUP BY cntrycode ORDER BY cntrycode;
